threads.body: [General] Changing this public factory's return type in the published `io.opentelemetry.instrumentation:opentelemetry-rxjava-1.0` artifact changes its JVM method descriptor. Previously compiled callers will fail with `NoSuchMethodError`, even if they assign the result to `Observable.OnSubscribe`; source callers assigning it to `TracedOnSubscribe` also lose compatibility. Preserve and deprecate the existing signature, and introduce the interface-returning factory under a different name. Include the replacement and removal timing in the deprecation Javadoc and add a deprecation CHANGELOG entry. The old signature can be removed in a subsequent alpha release.

replies.body: The binary and source break is intentional for this alpha artifact. The requested change is to the existing factory's return type, not to introduce another factory name. No stable API is changed. Commit 2271d09e records the break under the Unreleased non-stable API heading, and the PR description explains the result-type migration and recompilation requirement. Retaining the old signature is not required for this intentional alpha API change.

@copilot Update this PR directly with the remaining compatibility documentation from the original assignment. Do not create another PR.

The original cloud task explicitly requested a concise breaking-change changelog entry for changing TracedOnSubscribe.perSubscription(...) from TracedOnSubscribe<T, REQUEST> to rx.Observable.OnSubscribe<T>. The current PR diff at 696046f6de4e1ab88a366f560050fefde6d11a79 contains the return-type change and both convention documents, but no CHANGELOG.md entry. The RxJava 1.0 library is a published alpha artifact, and this changes the factory's JVM descriptor and can break source declarations using its concrete result type.

Add only the concise entry required by CONTRIBUTING.md under the appropriate Unreleased breaking-changes-to-non-stable-APIs heading. Describe the changed return type directly without redundant explanations. Preserve the latest user-requested shorter wording in docs/contributing/writing-instrumentation.md, the rule in .github/instructions/instrumentation-library.instructions.md, the production return-type change, and all existing tests. The user explicitly requested removal of the newly added perSubscriptionReturnsOnSubscribe test; do not restore it or add a replacement test.

Keep this coding follow-up limited to the missing changelog entry. Use the repository's scoped Markdown formatting/linting as appropriate. Do not change PR titles or descriptions, modify other APIs, post extra comments, or wait for CI.

replies.body: Added the concise breaking-change entry to the Unreleased changelog in 2271d09e.

threads.body: [General] This changes the source and binary signature of `TracedOnSubscribe.perSubscription()` in the published `opentelemetry-rxjava-1.0` alpha API. Existing compiled callers need recompilation, but the release documentation does not mention the break. `CONTRIBUTING.md:22–29` requires a breaking-change entry under `Unreleased` in addition to migration notes in the PR description. Please add a concise entry under the non-stable API breaking-changes heading naming the new `Observable.OnSubscribe<T>` return type.
